title: Convert raw bytes to an R array based on the specified data type information — convert_bytes_to_array
code: x <- matrix(c(3L, 6L, 2L, 1L, 12L, 0L), nrow = 2, ncol = 3) x #>      [,1] [,2] [,3] #> [1,]    3    2   12 #> [2,]    6    1    0  y <- writeBin(c(x), raw()) |>   convert_bytes_to_array("int", shape = c(2L, 3L), size = 4L, endian = "little") y #>      [,1] [,2] [,3] #> [1,]    3    2   12 #> [2,]    6    1    0 dim(y) #> [1] 2 3 is.array(y) #> [1] TRUE storage.mode(y) #> [1] "integer"
